assignments.value:
ORNEK 1
GORSEL PROMPT:
Create a premium, ultra-realistic commercial food advertisement for Casa restaurant.
FORMAT:

* Vertical 3:4 portrait
* Instagram feed advertisement
* Professional restaurant food photography

MAIN VISUAL:
Show a premium collection of Casa burgers on a dark walnut restaurant table.
There are 7 burger categories, and each category has:

* 1 beef burger
* 1 crispy chicken burger

Total: 14 burgers.
Arrange them neatly and elegantly. Do not create a chaotic pile. Make the burgers clearly visible.
BEEF BURGERS:
Premium grilled beef patties, toasted buns, fresh ingredients and realistic sauce.
CRISPY CHICKEN BURGERS:
Golden crispy chicken fillets, crunchy coating, toasted buns, fresh ingredients and realistic sauce.
The sauces must look natural and physically present inside the burgers.
PRODUCT NAMES:
Write these names EXACTLY as written below:
"Louisiana acı biber soslu burger"
"Chili Mayolu Burger"
"trüflü mayonezli burger"
"trüflü mayonezli acı soslu burger"
"Sriracha Mayolu Burger"
"Belçika Barbekülü Burger"
"Burger Soslu Burger"
Do not change, translate, shorten, capitalize differently or misspell any product name.
For "Burger Soslu Burger", use a classic creamy burger sauce.
For "trüflü mayonezli acı soslu burger", clearly show a realistic combination of truffle mayonnaise and spicy sauce inside the burger.
STYLE:
Premium Turkish restaurant advertising.
Dark walnut table.
Warm 3000–3200K restaurant lighting.
Warm amber background bokeh.
Natural realistic shadows.
Realistic food textures.
Professional Canon EOS R5 + 100mm macro photography look.
Natural optical depth of field.
Realistic lens compression.
High detail but completely photorealistic.
TEXT:
Main headline:
"YENİ SOSLU BURGERLER"
Subheadline:
"Et veya çıtır tavuk seçenekleriyle"
Place each product name clearly beside its corresponding burger pair.
LOGO:
Use the uploaded Casa logo exactly as provided.
Do not redraw, recreate, recolor, restyle, distort or modify the logo.
IMPORTANT:
Real photographed food appearance.
No CGI.
No 3D render.
No floating burgers.
No plastic-looking food.
No fake smoke.
No excessive steam.
No fog.
No glowing effects.
No distorted buns.
No malformed patties.
No duplicated burgers.
No missing burger versions.
No invented product names.
No changed product names.
No spelling mistakes.
No chaotic composition.
Final result must look like a premium professionally photographed Casa restaurant advertisement.

ACIKLAMA:
Yeni soslu burgerler Casa’da!

Louisiana acı biber soslu, Chili Mayolu, trüflü mayonezli, trüflü mayonezli acı soslu, Sriracha Mayolu, Belçika Barbekülü ve Burger Soslu Burger seçenekleri seni bekliyor.

Üstelik hepsinde **Et veya Çıtır Tavuk** seçeneği var.

Canın hangisini çektiyse, Casa’dan söyle.

📲 Uber Eats • Yemeksepeti • GetirYemek • Migros Yemek

ETIKETLER:
#Casa #CasaBurger #Burger #Hamburger #SosluBurger #ÇıtırTavukBurger #EtBurger #AdanaBurger #AdanaYemek #Sarıçam #Adana #BurgerLovers #YemekSiparişi

ORNEK 2
GORSEL PROMPT:
Create a premium, extremely photorealistic restaurant advertisement photograph for Casa.
ABSOLUTE OUTPUT FORMAT

* Exact Instagram Feed portrait format: 4:5
* Exact final size: 1080 × 1350 pixels
* NOT square 1:1
* NOT 3:4
* NOT 9:16 Story/Reels
* Compose the entire scene specifically for the 4:5 frame from the beginning.
* Do NOT generate another aspect ratio and crop it afterward.
* Keep every important element safely inside the frame.
* Nothing important may be cropped, cut off, or touch the edges.

MAIN COMPOSITION
Create one premium hero pizza as the clear focal point.
The pizza must look like a real pizza photographed inside a real restaurant, physically placed on a dark walnut wooden table.
The pizza should have:

* Naturally irregular handmade dough
* Realistic browned and slightly blistered crust
* Natural leopard-style char spots
* Properly baked edges
* Real melted mozzarella
* Realistic tomato sauce
* Natural cheese bubbling
* Realistic toppings
* Slight natural oil and moisture
* Small imperfections that make it look genuinely handmade

The pizza must NOT look perfectly symmetrical or artificially manufactured.
CHEESE PULL
One pizza slice is being naturally lifted upward from the pizza.
The lifted slice must remain physically connected to the main pizza through real melted cheese.
The cheese pull must be:

* Physically believable
* Irregular and organic
* Several thin and medium cheese strands
* Natural elasticity
* Correct gravity
* Slight stretching and separation
* Realistic melted cheese texture

Absolutely NO cartoon-like cheese.
NO impossibly long cheese strings.
NO plastic-looking cheese.
NO floating slice.
The lifted slice must look like a real person has just picked it up from the pizza.
PHYSICAL REALISM
Everything must exist in the same physical environment.
The pizza, plate/table surface, lifted slice and cheese must obey real-world physics.
Use:

* Realistic contact shadows
* Ambient occlusion
* Correct perspective
* Correct scale
* Natural depth
* Realistic reflections
* Realistic light falloff
* Consistent exposure
* Consistent white balance
* Consistent color temperature

The pizza must visibly sit on the table.
NO floating objects.
NO cut-out PNG appearance.
NO pasted/composited food.
NO fake drop shadows.
NO CGI appearance.
NO 3D-rendered appearance.
NO plastic textures.
CAMERA / FOOD PHOTOGRAPHY
Make it look like a professionally photographed premium restaurant advertisement.
Professional full-frame camera aesthetic, similar to a Canon EOS R5 with a 100mm macro lens.
Use:

* Real optical depth of field
* Natural lens compression
* Sharp focus on the pizza
* Realistic background blur
* Subtle bokeh
* Natural micro-contrast
* High-end commercial food photography
* Realistic texture detail

Do NOT use excessive HDR, excessive sharpening, artificial clarity, or an overprocessed social-media look.
The image should look like it was captured by a professional food photographer, not generated by AI.
LIGHTING / ENVIRONMENT
Dark walnut restaurant table.
Background should have a subtle, elegant restaurant atmosphere with warm amber/golden bokeh.
Lighting temperature approximately 3000–3200K.
Use soft, directional restaurant lighting with realistic highlights on:

* Melted cheese
* Crust
* Toppings
* Sauce
* Table surface

Shadows must be soft and physically consistent with the light source.
NO excessive smoke.
NO dramatic artificial steam.
NO thick fog.
NO glowing food.
NO unrealistic light rays.
If any steam is visible, it must be extremely subtle and physically realistic.
HEADLINE
Add the headline:
“HÂLÂ DENEMEDİN Mİ?”
Typography should be:

* Premium
* Clean
* Modern
* Highly readable
* Suitable for a professional Turkish restaurant advertisement

Position the headline so it does not cover the hero pizza or cheese pull.
The typography must look naturally designed as part of a professional advertisement, not randomly placed.
CASA LOGO — ABSOLUTE REQUIREMENT
Use the Casa logo provided by the user as the exact original logo.
The uploaded logo must be used exactly as supplied.
DO NOT:

* Redraw it
* Recreate it
* Modify it
* Restyle it
* Recolor it
* Change its typography
* Change its proportions
* Change any letters
* Add effects
* Remove elements
* Generate a similar logo

The logo must remain visually identical to the supplied reference.
Place it naturally within the advertisement with sufficient clear space.
FINAL VISUAL STYLE
The final image should feel like a real premium restaurant campaign photograph suitable for Casa's Instagram account.
The viewer should immediately focus on the pizza and the realistic cheese pull.
The overall result should be:

* Premium
* Appetizing
* Authentic
* Warm
* Modern
* Professional
* Photorealistic

Avoid anything that makes the image look AI-generated.
NEGATIVE REQUIREMENTS
No AI-looking food.
No CGI.
No 3D render.
No illustration.
No cartoon.
No fake food.
No floating pizza.
No floating slice.
No pasted food.
No cutout effect.
No unrealistic cheese.
No excessive cheese stretching.
No plastic cheese.
No excessive steam.
No thick smoke.
No fog.
No artificial glow.
No fake shadows.
No inconsistent lighting.
No inconsistent perspective.
No warped pizza.
No deformed toppings.
No malformed crust.
No duplicated toppings.
No strange objects.
No excessive HDR.
No oversharpening.
No unnatural saturation.
No cropped pizza.
No cropped slice.
No cropped logo.
No cropped headline.
The final image must be a true 4:5 Instagram feed composition at 1080×1350 pixels, with all important visual elements fully inside the frame.

ACIKLAMA:
İncecik hamur, çıtır kenarlar, bol peynir ve fırından çıkan sıcacık pizza. 🍕
Bir dilim yetmez, bizden söylemesi.

📲 Uber Eats • Yemeksepeti • GetirYemek • Migros Yemek

ETIKETLER:
#Casa #CasaPizza #Pizza #AdanaPizza #Sarıçam #AdanaYemek #PizzaLovers #YemekSiparişi

(Alternatif aciklama ayni gorsel icin:)
Hâlâ denemedin mi? 🍕
Çıtır kenarı, bol peyniri ve sıcacık lezzetiyle Casa Pizza seni bekliyor.

#Casa #CasaRestoran #Adana #Sarıçam #AdanaPizza #Pizza #PizzaLovers #AdanaYemek #YemekSiparişi #OnlineSipariş

ORNEK 3
GORSEL PROMPT:
Create a PREMIUM, PHOTOREALISTIC restaurant advertisement for CASA, specifically designed as a vertical Instagram feed post.
FORMAT:
4:5 vertical Instagram feed format.
1080 × 1350 composition.
All important text, logo and ordering-platform logos must remain safely inside the Instagram crop area.
BRAND & LOGO
The attached Casa logo is the restaurant's official brand logo.
CRITICAL LOGO INSTRUCTION:
Use the PROVIDED CASA LOGO EXACTLY as supplied.
Do NOT: redraw, recreate, redesign the logo; change its typography, colors or proportions; stretch, distort, simplify or reinterpret it; replace it with AI-generated text; create an alternative Casa logo.
The supplied Casa logo must remain visually identical to the original reference.
Place the logo naturally in a clean premium position, preferably in the upper portion of the composition.
MAIN CONCEPT
Create a restaurant advertisement built around the message: “HÂLÂ DENEMEDİN Mİ?”
Secondary text: “BURGER • MAKARNA • PİZZA”
The visual should immediately make the viewer hungry and curious about Casa.
FOOD — HIGHEST PRIORITY
Show THREE hero food products together: 1. PREMIUM BURGER 2. CREAMY PASTA 3. FRESHLY BAKED PIZZA
The food must look like REAL FOOD photographed by a professional restaurant photographer. The biggest priority is PHOTOREALISM.
The food must NOT look like AI-generated food, 3D render, CGI, plastic food, cutout images, PNG objects, stickers, digitally pasted photographs.
The three dishes must look as if they were PHYSICALLY PRESENT ON THE TABLE AT THE EXACT MOMENT THE PHOTOGRAPH WAS TAKEN.
PHYSICAL CONTACT & GROUNDING
The burger, pasta plate and pizza must physically interact with the table surface. Every object must have realistic contact shadows, subtle ambient occlusion, realistic weight, natural grounding, soft shadows directly beneath objects, realistic reflections where appropriate.
Nothing may appear to float. NO visible gap between plates and the table. NO artificial drop shadows. NO dark outlines around the food. The food must naturally belong to the environment.
CAMERA & PERSPECTIVE
The entire composition must look like ONE SINGLE PHOTOGRAPH captured with ONE physical camera. All dishes share the same perspective, camera height, viewing angle, focal characteristics, lens behavior and depth of field. Do NOT composite separately photographed food. Use a professional full-frame camera with a high-end 100mm food-photography lens.
DEPTH OF FIELD
Use REAL optical depth of field. Closer objects sharper, farther objects naturally softer. No artificial background cutout blur.
LIGHTING
All food and the environment are illuminated by the SAME physical light source (same direction, softness, intensity, color temperature, highlights, shadows). Warm cinematic restaurant lighting around 3000–3200K with subtle warm amber/golden bokeh in the background.
TABLE & ENVIRONMENT
Realistic dark walnut restaurant table with natural wood texture, subtle imperfections and realistic reflections. The dishes actually sit on this table. The environment feels like a real restaurant photographed at the same moment as the food.
BURGER REALISM
Premium beef burger: naturally toasted glossy bun, realistic bun pores, irregular natural shape, juicy beef patty with grilled texture, naturally melted cheese, fresh ingredients, realistic moisture, subtle imperfections. Not perfectly symmetrical.
PASTA REALISM
Freshly prepared restaurant pasta: naturally varying shapes, realistic cooked texture, sauce naturally coating the pasta, realistic sauce viscosity and pooling, subtle highlights, natural portion shape, not perfectly arranged. Plate is real ceramic with contact shadows.
PIZZA REALISM
Freshly baked pizza: irregular hand-shaped dough, realistic browned crust, subtle charred areas, naturally melted cheese, uneven cheese distribution, realistic toppings, natural baked texture, realistic moisture. Not a mathematically perfect circle.
FOOD MATERIAL REALISM
Cheese soft and melted; meat with visible fibers; bread porous; sauce with natural viscosity; pizza dough with natural air pockets; plates real ceramic.
COLOR & EXPOSURE
Match exposure, white balance, contrast, saturation, color temperature and dynamic range across the whole photograph. No oversaturation, no excessive HDR, no over-sharpening.
COMPOSITION
Natural triangular composition with burger, pasta and pizza as the three hero elements, all clearly recognizable, large enough to look appetizing on a smartphone. Balanced and premium, not overcrowded. Leave clean space for the headline and Casa logo.
TEXT
Main headline: “HÂLÂ DENEMEDİN Mİ?”
Secondary line: “BURGER • MAKARNA • PİZZA”
Clean, bold, modern premium restaurant typography, highly readable on mobile. No text over important food details. No extra slogans. No prices or discounts.
ORDERING PLATFORMS
At the bottom create a clean professional ordering footer. Display ONLY these four delivery platform logos: Uber Eats, Yemeksepeti, GetirYemek, Migros Yemek. Use the official logos accurately, do not redesign or distort them. Equal visual prominence, arranged horizontally with clean spacing, like a professional ordering section, NOT random stickers.
ABSOLUTELY AVOID
Floating food, pasted-on food, cutout appearance, PNG/sticker look, artificial drop shadows, mismatched lighting or perspective, impossible proportions, excessive smoke, fake steam, plastic cheese, rubber meat, artificial glossy sauce, perfectly symmetrical food, CGI/cartoon/surreal look, excessive HDR or sharpening, fake depth of field around cutouts, distorted or fake Casa logo.
FINAL REALISM TEST
The final image MUST look like a genuine professional restaurant photograph: could a real photographer have placed this food on this exact table, used one camera, taken one photograph and produced this exact image? If anything looks composited, pasted, floating or separately photographed, correct perspective, lighting, shadows, reflections, depth of field, scale and physical contact until it looks like ONE REAL PHOTOGRAPH.

ACIKLAMA:
(Ornek 3 icin aciklama verilmedi; ornek 1 ve 2'nin tarzini kullan.)

assignments.name: rules
assignments.value:
DUKKAN: Casa restoran, Sarıçam / Adana. Menu odagi: burger, makarna, pizza. Siparis platformlari: Uber Eats, Yemeksepeti, GetirYemek, Migros Yemek.
SABIT KURALLAR (her yeni image_prompt'ta aynen korunmali): 4:5, 1080x1350 Instagram feed; koyu ceviz masa; 3000-3200K sicak isik; amber bokeh; Canon EOS R5 + 100mm macro hissi; gercek fotograf gorunumu, CGI/3D/yuzen yemek/plastik gorunum YOK; Casa logosu verildigi gibi kullanilir, degistirilmez; onemli hicbir sey kirpilmaz; fiyat/indirim yok; urun adlari uydurulmaz, ornekteki adlar aynen yazilir.
DEGISECEK: ana yemek (burger/makarna/pizza ve cesitleri), kompozisyon, basliga ait Turkce kisa slogan, ek detaylar. Her gun bir oncekinden farkli konu sec.
ACIKLAMA: Turkce, samimi, emojili, kisa; sonunda '📲 Uber Eats • Yemeksepeti • GetirYemek • Migros Yemek' satiri. ETIKETLER: #Casa #Adana #Sarıçam #AdanaYemek ile baslayip konuya uygun toplam 8-12 etiket.
